newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms long, short-term ratings of P&O.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms long, short-term ratings of P&O.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Monday it had confirmed The Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Company's (P&O) long- and short-term ratings at A minus and A2 respectively.
"This follows today's announcement that P&O is to merge its container business in a 50:50 joint venture with Royal Nedlloyd NV," IBCA said in a statement.
"This merger with Royal Nedlloyd fits in with this strategy and in addition to raising funds in the near future, should be cash positive in the longer term," IBCA said.
"The merged business will be self financing, responsible for its own capital expenditure, and is anticipated to generate cost savings of at least $200 million," it said.
But is said that although the merger was positive from a financial perspective for P&O, the need to raise funds from asset disposals was necessary to protect the company's financial position.
"(P&O) has large capital expenditure requirements over the next few years in some core businesses," IBCA said.
It said that together with the targeted increase in return on capital employed to 15 percent, asset disposals would help to fund future capital expenditure.
